description: Returns the historical changelog of MFN duty rates (and adjacent fields) for a Swiss customs tariff (HS8) code, across every dated release we have archived (history deepens over time from launch). Irreplicable by scraping — xtares.admin.ch only serves the current version. Requires `hs8`; optional `since` (ISO date) to bound the window.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only changes recorded on/after are returned

name: tariff_changelog
